mentions.name: Long scrolling page design tool
mentions.description: A tool for designing longer scrolling pages with multiple sections that preserves the visual look and feel while drastically speeding up the experience. Generation of the page takes on the order of tens of seconds (the demo video has 32 seconds of generation time cut out), and it has not launched yet.
mentions.problem: Designing longer scrolling pages with multiple sections is slow, especially while trying to preserve the visual look and feel.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a better way to design longer scrolling pages with multiple sections, while preserving the visual look/feel and drastically speeding up the experience.

Here's a demo: https://non.io/video/linen-demo.mp4
mentions.author: jjcm
